instruction: A minimalist studio portrait photograph, captured in a medium close-up shot at eye-level against a solid beige background. The man in the white t-shirt (R1) stands on the left in profile facing left. The man in the pink t-shirt (R2) stands behind him, resting his head flat on R1's shoulder and looking directly at the camera with a soft, contemplative gaze. R2 embraces R1 from behind, resting his right hand on R1's shoulder and wrapping his other arm around R1's waist. The lighting is soft and diffused, casting gentle shadows and highlighting the warm, pastel color palette of their clothing against the neutral backdrop.
